description: Analyze a Canadian rental property: capitalization rate, net operating income, gross rent multiplier, expense ratio, annual cash flow and cash-on-cash return, plus how the cap rate compares to typical yields in the local market. Mortgage math uses Canadian semi-annual compounding.

annualOperatingExpenses.description: Total annual operating expenses in CAD (property tax, insurance, management, maintenance, landlord utilities) — excludes mortgage payments

city.description: City used for the cap-rate benchmark range

downPayment.description: Down payment in CAD. Set equal to purchasePrice for an all-cash purchase.

interestRatePct.description: Mortgage rate as a percent, e.g. 5.49

monthlyGrossRent.description: Total gross monthly rent across all units in CAD

vacancyRatePct.description: Vacancy allowance as a percent of gross rent

name: cap_rate
title: Cap Rate & Rental Property Calculator (Canada)
